Trigger A creature within range is about to make a check.

Family Monitor

Anima Weapon @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.C2gozUsiTlOdrAO6]{Anima Weapon: Rewind Streams}

Anima Morph @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.317pj4o79aj9ZDSt]{Anima Morph: Rewind Streams}

Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.357bmEWSDo4kA0pC]{Anima Ability: Rewind Streams}

You rearrange a singular potential outcome within acceptable boundaries by forwarding that potential elsewhere. The triggering creature takes either a -1 status penalty or a +1 status bonus to their check, and then gains the opposite effect on their next check within the spell’s duration. These effects gain the fortune or misfortune trait respectively.

@UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.mkrcu4qyw0opxoum]{Spell Effect: Rewind Streams}

Heightened (+3) You can choose to increase the status penalty or bonus and their subsequent opposite effect by 1.
